text.p: Espanyol beat the Spanish transfer deadline by hours on Wednesday to sign French goalkeeper Pascal Olmeta, who was dismissed by Lyon last week after injuring a team mate.
Espanyol also announced that Romanian striker Florin Raducioiu would return to the club after a spell on loan at England's West Ham.

The arrival of Olmeta is likely to end speculation that Espanyol would replace injured 'keeper Toni Jimenez with Real Madrid veteran Paco Buyo, who has lost his place since the arrival of former German international Bodo Illgner.

But Espanyol have decided to release Pepe Carcelen, the coach whose resignation on Monday gave way to the reappointment of Vicente Miera. Carcelen had been expected to return to his job as deputy first-team coach.
Celta Vigo confirmed the purchase of Moises Garcia from Leganes after talks between the second division's leading goalscorer and English club Sheffield Wednesday broke down.
